The Trading Mermaid and Blue Sky's First Love
synopsis: Sara, a mermaid living in the modern world, has been dealing with yokai and humans alike as a “Trader.” To her, humans are merely clients—trusting them with her heart was never an option… One day, a mysterious young man named Sora wanders into her miniature garden. He doesn’t seem like an enemy, but there’s clearly something unusual about him. Sara offers him a deal. However, the one thing Sora truly desires turns out to be none other than Sara herself…!? A cohabitation romance filled with love and secrets begins—all starting from a single “deal”! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Hitozuma Kyoushi ga Oshiego no Joshikousei ni Dohamari Suru Hanashi
titleRomaji: Hitozuma Kyoushi ga Oshiego no Joshikousei ni Dohamari Suru Hanashi
titleNative: 人妻教師が教え子の女子高生にドはまりする話
synopsis: Itsuki Ichigohara is a married high-school teacher in her late 20's, who finds herself involved with a high school girl, her student, who is 10 years younger. The student's name is Rin Togawa. She is taller than Itsuki, with a beautiful face, mild-mannered but a little childish. She is a good girl, but she has had problems in her family life, and as Itsuki tried to counsel her, they somehow ended up kissing each other in bed. This is definitely an adulterous betrayal, not to mention a crime. How could she have got herself into so much trouble that could only lead to her own destruction? — How could I have let this happen? It is a lewd and immoral, but somehow warm relationship. A love story between a female teacher and her female student. (Source: Kadokawa, translated)
